purpose: apply the already-retained source-continuous quote-change and current 24-hour trade-count rejection gates to every exact three-leg candidate without inspecting identities first or issuing a request

parent_result.candidate_set: all 253 exact empirical route-size candidates with no additions omissions ranking filter or identity inspection

retained_activity.reuse_rule: do not refetch the same rolling activity population

activity_gates.required_symbols: the direct symbol and all three exact three-leg path symbols
activity_gates.quote_change_definition: count a change when bid price bid quantity ask price or ask quantity differs from the preceding retained full-book response
activity_gates.ticker_presence: each required symbol must have one valid retained 24-hour row
activity_gates.interpretation: stale and inactive display rejection only; never proof of fills quote age or sequential completion

survivor_boundary.accepted_scoped_mechanism_extension: if at least one exact parent candidate passes every activity gate, extend the already-accepted organic-conversion comparison from best direct-or-one-intermediary to best direct-or-one-or-two-intermediary under the same fail-closed account and execution boundary
survivor_boundary.next_evidence: exact account symbol commissions plus one future independent non-overlapping prospective paper or separately authorized owned sequential completion window for an independently required legitimate organic conversion

retention.keep_every_tested_candidate: retain identity size four symbol activity values economics and pass or reject decision for all 253 rows

prohibited_shortcuts: promoting a static route because it survives activity
treating activity as fillability latency atomicity or realized savings
dropping rejected candidates or weakening thresholds
creating splitting rerouting self-matched or wash volume
requesting credentials accounts orders funds or protected capture state
